claims.summary: One fail-closed audit reconstructs both source-capture campaigns and verifies 24 retained projects covering 12 groups, 48 prompts, and 192 requested atoms per arm before replaying current compiler admission.
The same current compiler raises local Gemma contract admission from 132/192 to 168/192 and GPT-5.4-mini from 177/192 to 182/192, measuring a 36-atom local lift and a 5-atom reference lift.
The measured cross-arm admission gap falls from 45 atoms to 14, a 31-atom or 68.8889% reduction, while both arms reach 86/96 MC contract admissions without creating a semantic-quality claim.

All 14 remaining cross-arm admission differences are local key terms: twelve correction-repeats-definition failures, one invalid source-fact index, and one missing expected seat, exposing the next adapter target without inventing a compiler repair.

The receipt is limited to deterministic contract admission on retained responses; it makes no new model call or factual, educational, model, adapter, held-out, paid-reference-quality, independent-review, or human-validation claim, and public Scion remains base-only.
